battery_procurement_spec: Candidate Liter-3020030 120mAh 20C cell; finished protected 1S pack with NTC must be <=21x33x3mm including tolerances. Supplier confirmation REQUIRED; not a qualified off-the-shelf pack.
battery_fixation: 0.1 mm PET + 0.2 mm removable adhesive against empty underside of controls PCB; pull tab; no hard clamp
assembly_option: CN2/CN3 headers omitted; AWG30 flexible pigtails, insulation OD <=0.55 mm, soldered to existing PCB pads
mainboard_screws: 4 x M2 x 4 mm, head <=3.6 mm diameter and <=1.0 mm height, hand-tapped pilots, low torque
rear_cover_screws: 2 x M1.6 x 6 mm, verify actual head diameter <=3.2 mm
controls_screws: 3 x M1.6 x 2.5 UNDER HEAD, head <=D3.3 x0.5; each with ID1.7 OD4 thickness0.3 washer
resin: tough engineering SLA resin; remove all support and post-cure before assembly
controls_edge_capture: Right PCB edge at case Y55.45..56.65, with 0.2 mm insulating pad; no screw across FFC
rear_cover_inserts: 2 x M1.6x0.35, OD2.5 x L3.0 mm, headless knurled brass, cold glued
rear_insert_example: In-saiL MT-M1.6x3.0-OD2.5; verify actual widest OD and length before gluing
rear_insert_installation: Cold glue after full resin post-cure; seat to shoulder without force; no heat-setting. Fit and glue strength require physical tests.
lcd_mount: Two integral rails + 0.20 mm back-face foam adhesive strips, installed from front before cover lens
motor_carrier: Separate printed part, glued after controls; rear PCB is installed last
key_printing: Single parts without sacrificial carriers; wheel 2.15 mm, center 2.05 mm axial envelope
